stem: A control suppresses the target pest but kills most beneficial organisms and the pest rapidly rebounds. What should the recurrence review examine?
choices: Only whether the first pest count was written in ink.
Compatibility, selection pressure, prevention/source controls, monitoring timing and whether the intervention disrupted the larger IPM system.
Whether the beneficial organisms had names.
Nothing, because initial suppression proves success.
rationale: Program learning should examine compatibility and system effects, not just short-term target suppression.
